svg.title: PortableSatStation conceptual Powerpole and fused power distribution
svg.desc: FIG-05 conceptual functional power topology; no released power schematic or auxiliary hardware exists. External battery connects through a TBD Powerpole pair, pack-adjacent positive master fuse, service disconnect, coordinated protection and conditioning, protected distribution and separately fused branches. The common-mode choke is optional and carries both conductors; differential LC stays DNP until converter stability guidance, damping analysis and measurements qualify an exact network. Motor hard-limit, watchdog and DC-rated latching E-stop power-cut guard are not designed/released; GPIO inputs/requests are not hardware permits. Not wiring authorization, a schematic or fabrication drawing.
svg.text: FIG-05 - External battery input and fused power distribution
Functional topology only; ratings, conductor sizes, connector orientation, and electrical implementation require released design and measurement.
BMS is not the branch fuse
After F0 / S0: protection + inrush control
Optional CM choke on + and return
USB-C: verified CM5 I/O board POWER input only
USB host/data for 2 LimeSDRs separate; no PD/USB3 assumption
return polarity and board connection verified from released docs
E-stop path is not an unrated switch in motor current.
Protection, branch filters, and return-path design gates - MMA-028 / MMA-049
At least one source-positive master fuse plus separate F1 / F2 / F3 branch protection.
Fuse current values are NOT selected: measure continuous loads and startup/inrush first.
Select DC voltage / interrupt ratings and time-current curve against actual source fault current.
Choose wire gauge and length from ampacity, ambient/bundling, round-trip drop, and fault limits.
Check Powerpole contacts, crimps/tool, housing/mating key, holder, disconnect, and bus ratings.
Battery BMS is not a replacement for the close-to-source fuse or separate branch fuses.
Red/black are only marks: verify mate orientation and polarity with a DMM at both ends.
After F0 / S0: TVS + reverse protection; optional common-mode choke on BOTH DC conductors.
Each branch: local decoupling; any differential LC needs vendor guidance, damping/stability analysis.
LC is DNP until qualified. No EMI immunity/attenuation is claimed; auxiliary power hardware is unreleased.
No fuse, filter, wire gauge or Powerpole SKU is approved; verify actual DC ratings and source fault current.
Cold assembly / first-power order - only after released schematic and safety hardware
1 Isolate/remove battery -> 2 remove all fuses -> 3 build/strain-relieve harness -> 4 DMM continuity, isolation, polarity and NC checks
5 install verified branch fuses -> 6 install source/master fuse LAST (battery disconnected) -> 7 reconnect with S0 OPEN, TX inhibited; current-limited first power
GPIO NC inputs are monitors only; GPIO/expander enable outputs are requests, NOT hardware permits. Independent hard-stop/watchdog/E-stop guard is not released.
EMI: rated 50-ohm RX loads, TX off; log converter/motor-chopper off/on. Damped LC DNP pending stability/vendor review. No immunity claim.
